date_basis: Artifact date follows the user's Asia/Shanghai execution date. All recorded_at timestamps remain ISO 8601 UTC. The native QA session crosses local dates 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-14; individual case timestamps are authoritative.
verification_scope: Actual native iOS Simulator UI observations against the unchanged isolated Rust backend on port 3301, corroborated only where stated by authenticated HTTP GETs and Mongo port 33018 read-only projections. This artifact must not consume fixture port 3303 case snapshots or counts.

environment.backend: Isolated unchanged local Rust backend on port 3301
environment.companion: Authenticated HTTP GET and Mongo port 33018 read-only projections where attached

evidence_handling: Cases come only from the separate real-backend native journal. Explicit operator outcomes are preserved; helper readback never creates a native pass. Attached readback is independently allowlisted, type checked and matched to its companion stage. Raw bodies, headers, account identifiers, secrets and private paths are omitted. Private screenshot manifests are not consumed; no screenshots are automatically exported. No fixture snapshots or request counts are consumed. Two representative screenshots were separately inspected, decoded to RGB and re-encoded without metadata before adding their repository-relative references; screenshots do not create passes.
scope_limits: Only root's actually executed native flows may be marked pass
Stored active state does not establish provider credential validity or successful execution
Credential epoch delta establishes stored replacement relative to captured baseline; no external provider invocation
Helper session revoked flag and HTTP rejection establish that helper's revocation; native UI must separately establish current native session continuity
No Assistant inference, real OAuth, real push delivery, native release build or physical-device claims unless separately executed and evidenced

cases.observation: Submitted the existing disposable QA account through the native password form after switching the app to the unchanged isolated backend. The native workspace opened and Settings displayed the original QA name. Matching authenticated HTTP and database baseline reads confirmed the expected profile and an empty live connection list.

Saved the temporary display name through the native account form, left the page and reopened it. The saved value remained visible and Save profile was disabled. Corresponding authenticated HTTP and database reads both matched the expected saved name.

Submitted the native OpenAI connection form with the disposable QA label and an inert credential. After declining the system password-save prompt, the app visibly showed the active enabled detail. Matching HTTP and database readback found one active target and captured its initial credential epoch. No provider request was made.

Turned Allow this connection off in the native detail and observed Disabled with the switch off. Matching authenticated HTTP and database reads both showed the tracked connection inactive while its credential epoch remained at the creation baseline.

Turned Allow this connection back on in the native detail and observed Enabled with the switch on. Matching authenticated HTTP and database reads showed the same tracked connection active again without changing its initial credential epoch.

Saved a replacement inert credential through the native detail. Credential replaced appeared and the field returned to its empty placeholder with Save new credential disabled. Real-backend reads retained the active connection and showed a credential epoch increase of one from creation. External credential validity was not tested.

Opened Remove connection, observed its named confirmation and chose Cancel. The native active enabled detail remained. Real-backend readback retained the same active target and its replaced credential epoch, showing that cancellation did not remove it.

Confirmed removal through native UI, switched back to Connected and cleared its search. Connection removed and the unfiltered first-service empty state were visible. Real-backend reads showed the tracked service tombstoned and inactive, its key removed, and both authenticated API and live database lists empty.

Restored the original disposable account display name through the native account form. The app displayed Profile updated and disabled Save profile. Separate real-backend HTTP and Mongo readback both matched the original name, with the live service lists still empty.

Revoked the prepared other session from the native Sessions list after identifying its creation time and helper marker. The app displayed Session signed out and removed the helper row. Refreshing sessions, returning to Settings and reopening Account and security retained the separate current native session and original profile. The helper database row was revoked and both helper protected reads returned unauthorized.

Confirmed Sign Out through the native Settings alert after finishing the real-backend batch. The app returned to the login screen with empty email and password fields, disabled Sign In and no social-login error. This record observes native UI logout and does not claim a separate current-session HTTP revocation readback.
